# ui-tabs

> Tab container managing tab selection, panel visibility, and a sliding indicator.

**Class:** `UITabs`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | Currently selected tab value |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables all tabs |
| `orientation` | `string` | Layout direction: "horizontal" | "vertical" |

## Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-change` | Fired when the active tab changes with `{ value, label }` detail |

## CSS Tokens

Public `--ui-*` custom properties consumed by this component:

- `--ui-focus-ring`
- `--ui-font-weight-button`
- `--ui-line-height-control`
- `--ui-tabs-indicator`
